title: Lowered upper bounds for 7 counts (n = 210, 260, 262, 268, 272, 292, 295) and 6 exact 12-place refinements (n = 147, 156, 180, 270, 299, 307): registration request
body:
**Credit name.** Mykhailo Polkovskyi (GitHub: [Mishapolk](https://github.com/Mishapolk)).

**Claim.** Thirteen exact rational unit-square packings strictly lowering the standing 12-decimal ceiling (`ceil_12`) upper bounds on `main` at commit `f9ddfeeef9070ede581142154ab992149b278ab0` of `jlevy/squares`, every entry in `packing/frontier/results.yaml`, and all open registration requests (`#1005`, `#1006`, `#1007`). Each certificate proves feasibility $s(n) \le S$ at its stated exact rational side $S$.

**Checking.**

1. `python3 verify_bound_certificate.py --strict certificates/0000-0999/n{147,156,180,210,260,262,268,270,272,292,295,299,307}.cert` — Python `fractions.Fraction`; checks $c_i^2 + s_i^2 = 1$, open-container inclusion in $(0, S)^2$, and strict separating-axis disjointness (`< 3 s`).
2. `python3 verify_area_exact.py --strict certificates/0000-0999/n{147,156,180,210,260,262,268,270,272,292,295,299,307}.cert` — Python `fractions.Fraction`; constructs four exact corners per square and verifies empty pairwise Sutherland–Hodgman clipped intersections (`overlaps = 0`, `< 5 s`).
3. `packing/devtools/check_rational_witness_independent.py` of `jlevy/squares` (`f9ddfeeef9070ede581142154ab992149b278ab0`) on `witnesses/2026-11-16/n-*.yaml` — `VERIFIED` across all $\binom{n}{2}$ pairs on all 13 files; `jsonschema` against `witness.schema.yaml` passes with 0 errors (`~12 s`).
4. `python3 verify_algebraic_bounds.py` — exact `fractions.Fraction` inequalities $2(S_{262} - 16)^2 < 1$, $(3S_{295} - 22)^2 < 968$, $S_{262}, S_{295} < S_{\#1007}$, and $S_{292} < S_{\#1006}$ (`< 0.1 s`).

**What the checkers share.** Checkers (1) and (2) share an author, Python's `fractions.Fraction`, and the `.cert` input files, but share no geometry code (1D separating-axis projections vs 2D polygon clipping). Checker (3) is `jlevy/squares`'s independent four-corner checker on the `Witness/v2` files and shares no code with (1) or (2).

**Not done.** Feasibility upper bounds $s(n) \le S$ only; no formal optimality proof or minimal polynomial is claimed.

**Lineage and credit.**

- **$n = 210, 262, 272, 292, 295$:** New packing arrangements below the standing bounds; primary credit to **Mykhailo Polkovskyi**.
- **$n = 260, 268$:** Improved packings below the standing bounds on `main`; credit **Mykhailo Polkovskyi** (after Evan Daniel at 260; after Doğa Özden at 268).
- **$n = 147, 156, 180, 270, 299, 307$:** Exact rational certificate refinements of the registered arrangements on `main`; arrangement credit remains with the standing authors, with certificate refinement credited to **Mykhailo Polkovskyi**.

**AI assistance.** Discovered by Mykhailo Polkovskyi, assisted by Gemini.
